scope: Partial profile verification; not full P0 or P5 acceptance

checks.legacy_profile_save: A biography-only save succeeded without changing the legacy language or DM privacy values; immediate reload returned the saved biography through the fixed user cache.
checks.registration_and_cache: Registration defaults and authenticated profile cache invalidation were exercised with SQLite and HTTP regression tests; the full Go suite passed on the isolated source snapshot with these backend changes.
checks.showcase: A synthetic favorite widget and manual link persisted after reload. A second synthetic account saw the visible link and did not receive it after visibility was disabled. Test data was removed.
checks.layout: Actual web UI showed no showcase grid overflow at widths 390, 768, 1024, 1440 and 2560 pixels; link fields were at least 288 pixels wide and action controls 36 pixels high.
checks.client: The scoped profile and locale suites passed 78 tests; production TypeScript and Vite build passed with the final profile changes. An earlier isolated client snapshot passed 4222 tests before the last showcase presentation changes.

limitations: This does not establish full visual, Windows device, multi-user, security or release acceptance.
The full client suite predates the final showcase presentation changes; the scoped suite and final build include them.
